Name: Cleaning requirements for cooling towers.
Title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to cleaning requirements for cooling towers

History.Description: This Introduction was Introduced by Council
This Introduction was Referred to Comm by Council to the Committee on Health

Summary: This bill would require that owners of buildings with cooling towers clean the cooling towers at least three times a year, with at least one of the three cleanings occurring during the months of June and July.
Text:
Be it enacted by the Council as follows:
      
      
      Section 1. Subdivision d of section 17-194.1 of the administrative code of the city of New York, as added by local law number 77 of the year 2015, is amended to read as follows:
      d. Cleaning and disinfection [after extended shut-down]. At a minimum, an owner shall [clean]:
      1. Clean and disinfect cooling towers that are shut-down for more than [five] 5 days. Cleaning and disinfection shall occur within 15 days before the use of such tower[.]; and
      2. Clean and disinfect cooling towers at least 3 times a year, including at least 1 time in June or July.
      � 2. This local law takes effect immediately.
